coastal.title: VIFF film Send the Rain explores Okinawan Canadian experience, set against the backdrop of wildfires
coastal.description: As wildfire closes in on her family’s farm, a young Okinawan Canadian journeys from the big city to rural B.C., to try to get her Oba — or grandmother — to evacuate. Erika, portrayed by Erika Prevost, wants her Oba with her in the city — but Oba believes Erika needs the farm.
